Resolves #20178

The root override's DOMPurify floor rises from `^3.4.16` to `^3.4.17`, which fixes Dependabot alerts 254–256 (one critical, one high, one low). Dependabot cannot move it: Monaco 0.57.0 exact-pins 3.4.15, so the root override supplies the version. The lock also takes body-parser 2.4.0 (GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828), which is inside express 5.2.1's range. It brings iconv-lite 0.7.3, which 2.4.0 requires. Nothing else in the lock moved.

Evidence: L2 (lock inspection, `npm audit`, both bundle builds, the Monaco component spec and the portal Mermaid e2e spec, all run locally) → L2 required (every AC is a property of the lock or of the built bundles). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: Shared PR Baseline / npm overrides. Locally, `npm ls dompurify body-parser` shows DOMPurify 3.4.17 under Mermaid and Monaco and body-parser 2.4.0, and `check-npm-overrides` reports 4 overrides, each still holding a floor a dependent needs. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: `npm run bundle-monaco` prints `DOMPurify 3.4.17`, and its build refuses a vendored copy or a second sanitizer. `dist/mermaid.mjs` carries `"3.4.17"`. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: `npm audit` reports 0 findings at head. |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: on the rebuilt bundles, `component/wrapper/MonacoEditor.spec.mjs` passes 9/9 and `e2e/portal/LearnMermaidRender.spec.mjs` passes 3/3. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The ticket named the parents from a stale local install, so its body is corrected in place to Mermaid 12.2.0 and webpack-dev-server 6.1.0, the versions in `dev`'s lock. The ranges and the fix are unchanged.

## Test Evidence
- Same instrument on base: `npm audit` on the base lock reports critical 2 and high 1 (DOMPurify, monaco-editor through it, body-parser). At head it reports 0.

## Post-Merge Validation
- None. GitHub closes alerts 254–256 by itself once this reaches `dev`.

Intake: self-authored this session. Prescription checked: a version that a root override supplies moves only by raising that override. create-app's scaffold copy follows at its next engine pin move, because its `check-engine-parity.mjs` requires that.

Related: #19635, #18354, #19320

Authored by Ada (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code). Session be08763b-ad29-4a7b-8f90-a8e06b01b8de.
